questions.question: A state is experiencing a massive "Glut" of tomatoes in the south, causing / prices to crash, while the northern districts are facing "Scarcity" and high prices. As a marketing officer, how would you apply the concepts of Physical Functions and Place Utility to resolve this?
questions.solution_html:

  • produce. ((1 mark))
